'''Jacen Yar''' was a [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]].

Yar led a party of bounty hunters to [[Almas]] after the destruction of [[Almas Academy]], in an effort to capture any [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] survivors. In the attempt, they encountered a group of salvagers called the [[Stalfonauts]], and the ensuing fight left both parties all dead.

A couple of years later, two [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] parasites&mdash;under the command of [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Valin Draco]] and the [[Gatekeeper/Legends|Gatekeeper]] of [[Darth Rivan's holocron]]&mdash;took control of the dead bodies, giving the illusion of the walking dead. These "zombies" were pitted against Jedi sympathizers trying to retrieve the [[Qornah Holocron]].
